tasks.corrected_reference_answer: NDIOMixin installs UnifiedReadWriteMethod descriptors for NDDataRead and NDDataWrite, whose calls delegate to the registry at runtime (astropy/nddata/mixins/ndio.py:56-114). The registry chooses the nearest registered ancestor using the MRO (astropy/io/registry/base.py:329-345). The property-based descriptor prevents instance attributes shadowing the interface (interface.py:147-155). New registrations therefore need not modify the mixin, but arbitrary replacement of existing handlers is not guaranteed to preserve behavior.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The test computes a good_enough date to match normal-config production selection and checks that selected files outlive it (astropy/utils/iers/tests/test_leap_second.py:230-234,322-329). Production computes today plus 180 minus auto_max_age days, using 30 when auto_max_age is None (iers.py:1158-1159), and stops searching when the best candidate expires after that threshold (1194-1198). The system-file test skips when its fixture fails this future-validity condition. The threshold is stricter than merely being unexpired today, and the formulas should not be described as identical for every configuration.
